unitTitle: A2 capstone: handle a changing week
title: Reading practice
subtitle: A2 · Unit 12: A2 capstone: handle a changing week

steps.explain: The message says Thursday at 18 h.
steps.promptFr: HORAIRE — Réunion : jeudi à 18 h, pas mardi. Nouveau point de départ : entrée principale.

steps.explain: The schedule gives the appointment on Thursday at 14 h.
steps.promptFr: HORAIRE PROVISOIRE — Cours : mercredi 18 h. Rendez-vous : jeudi 14 h. Révision : samedi matin.

steps.prompt: Why might the writer choose the second option?
options: Its starting point is closer to the centre
It is at a different time
steps.explain: The note says its starting point is closer, although it is longer.
steps.promptFr: NOTE — J'ai lu l'avis. La deuxième option est plus longue, mais le point de départ est plus près du centre.

steps.prompt: What will the learner practise without help?
steps.explain: The sheet gives a 45-second speaking goal without help.
steps.promptFr: FICHE DE RÉVISION — Objectif : parler sans aide. Point à revoir : lui / leur. Prochaine étape : un nouvel essai vendredi.

steps.prompt: What does the sender ask the reader to confirm?
options: The new schedule and starting point
The practice score and review sheet
The route price and food order
The lesson level and study group
steps.explain: The sender asks for both the schedule and starting point.
steps.promptFr: MESSAGE — Nouvel horaire : jeudi. Pourriez-vous confirmer le point de départ ? Merci.
